rules.name: Data access layer
rules.description: All data fetching goes through typed functions in lib/data/. Components and pages under app/ and components/ must not call supabase.from(...) directly.

rules.name: RLS on every table
rules.description: Every new table in supabase/migrations/ must enable Row Level Security and define policies in the same migration.

rules.name: Additive migrations only
rules.description: Migrations may add tables, columns and indexes. They must not rename or drop existing tables or columns, because all environments share one Supabase project.

rules.name: Server-only secrets
rules.description: Only NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY may use the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix. ORS_API_KEY and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must never be used in client components or files marked 'use client'.

rules.name: No AI in the MVP
rules.description: Do not add LLM SDKs, AI API calls, embeddings or vector search. AI features are planned for a later phase.

rules.name: Approved vendors only
rules.description: Backend is Supabase only, maps are MapLibre or Leaflet with OpenStreetMap, routing is OpenRouteService, geocoding is Nominatim, UI is Tailwind and shadcn/ui. Flag any new vendor, SaaS, ORM or UI library.

rules.name: Ranking explains itself
rules.description: Every institution ranking result must include human-readable reasons in Polish. Ranking must fall back to PostGIS straight-line distance when OpenRouteService fails.

rules.name: Polish UI, English code
rules.description: User-facing text is Polish. Identifiers, comments, database names and commit messages are English. Use the domain names from docs/PRODUCT_SPEC.md section 12.
